ana: Heads-up — all-hands tomorrow 10:30 PT. Quick agenda below and a shared doc for Qs. Please drop any questions in this thread or add them to the doc. :loudspeaker:
ana: Agenda (40m): 10:30–10:45 Exec updates, 10:45–11:05 Product demos, 11:05–11:20 Focused Q&A, 11:20–11:30 Ops & hiring callouts. We’ll keep to time.
devrel: Agenda & Qs doc: <https://tiny.redwood/allhands-may|all-hands agenda + Qs> — add your name if you want priority.
mira: Can we make sure Dedicated SLA changes are covered? I have notes for customer-facing talking points.
tj: Yep — I’ll cover SLA slide + rollout plan. @mira please drop any specific phrasing into the doc so I can copy it into the slide.
allhands-bot: Reminder: add your question before 10:10 to be eligible for the prioritized queue. Poll will be open at 10:10.
samir: Quick question — will the auto-batching suggestions change the default SDK behavior or just the console recommendations? Need to know for customers running older SDK versions.
ellie: We’ll include a short note in the product demo. Auto-batching suggestions are opt-in for now; automatic suggestions roll out next week but not forced.
ana: Great — thanks. If any people need talking points for OKR syncs, DM me and I’ll share a one-pager. Recording will be posted in this channel after the meeting.
ops-bot: Recording posted: <https://videos.redwood/abcd|All-hands — May 24, 10:30 PT> — slides attached in the description.
tj: Slides uploaded: <https://drive.redwood/slides/allhands-may|slides> — demo code snippets are on slide 8 and 9.
mira: Post-meeting takeaways (brief): 1) Dedicated SLA: new target 99.9% for NA Dedicated clusters, rollout starts Jun 15. 2) Auto-batching suggestions: opt-in rollout next week; SDK default unchanged. 3) Hiring: SRE req opened, interview loop next week.
samir: Action items (from meeting): @eng-platform update SDK changelog by Jun 1; @docs publish migration + FAQ by Jun 3; @sales notify top 20 Dedicated customers about SLA changes this week.
devrel: :thumbsup: I’ll start a pinned thread to collect migration FAQs and customer-facing snippets.
ana: Thanks, everyone. I’ll send a short exec note with the decisions and key dates by EOD. If you want anything included in that note for your team, drop it here.
